# Jira connector

> Reads one Jira Cloud project's issues as record streams and carries out three actions on an issue (set_assignee, transition_issue, set_due_date) under the Brain's permits, behind the site's Knovas Link, so that Jira is one connector package of protocol v2 and no change to the Brain, Link, the runner or the Platform.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Status | planned |
| Level | 3 |
| Parent | `L2-CONNECTION` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira`
- `KnovasConnectorJira/pyproject.toml`
- `KnovasConnectorJira/requirements.txt`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-1` | Reading - a project's issues as record messages (fields by field id, computed from the edit metadata and the settings, links), the issue's change-log position as its version, complete generation listings with tombstones, and no report of an absence from a cut listing. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/records.py`; `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/connector.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-2` | The three actions - an exact preview from the edit metadata and the transitions, inexact for a computed field; a direct write only at the expected change-log position, with the permit marker in the same request; a receipt from a re-read; a repeat answered from the marker without a second write. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/connector.py` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/R-3` | The calls to Jira - the site and project from the source's settings, the credential from the site's environment in the Authorization header only, rate limits waited out, every failure a code without its text. | `KnovasConnectorJira/src/knovas_connector_jira/client.py` |

### Not responsible for

- Checking permits; Knovas Link checks them before the connector sees an act (the kit's base class re-checks only that each permit binds its own step).
- Changing a Brain fact; the next read of the project does (GI-CONN-04).
- Choosing the site or the project; both are the source's settings at the site (the founder named the pilot project, D-17 - configuration, not code).
- Undo, native review and unstage; not in V1 (the founder's decision of 2026-11-10).

### Terms

- change-log position (the id of an issue's newest change-log entry; the record's version and a permit's expected version)
- permit marker (the issue property knovas.permit.&lt;permit id>, written with the change, by which a repeat finds it)

A transition goes alone (grouping_unsupported with another step), and steps on several issues are refused grouping_across_items, never partly written. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_direct_write_sends_the_change_and_the_permit_marker_in_one_request`; `test_a_change_log_that_moved_past_the_expected_version_is_a_conflict_and_nothing_is_written`; `test_the_receipt_is_a_re_read_so_an_automation_that_changes_the_value_is_a_difference`; `test_a_transition_to_done_names_what_jira_set_besides_as_side_effects`; `test_two_field_edits_of_one_issue_are_one_edit_one_change_log_entry_and_one_receipt_per_step`; `test_a_transition_goes_alone`; `test_field_edits_of_two_issues_are_never_partly_written`; kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_conformance.py`, checks: `test_the_suite_passes_every_read_and_write_property` |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/call.knovas_connector_jira.connector.JiraConnector/L-1` | Jira has no conditional edit, so a change that lands between the version check and the write is not refused; it shows in the receipt (a side effect, or a difference when it touched the same field). | critical |  |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/call.knovas_connector_jira.connector.JiraConnector/L-2` | Atomic means one issue - field edits of several issues in one act are refused, so a change set that edits two issues cannot be written in one act under v2.0 (open question J-Q2); a transition and an edit of one issue in two acts against the one preview's version make the second a conflict (the Brain refuses such a change set). | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_field_edits_of_two_issues_are_never_partly_written`; `test_a_transition_after_an_edit_in_its_own_job_finds_the_change_log_moved` |
| `L3-JIRA-CONNECTOR/call.knovas_connector_jira.connector.JiraConnector/L-3` | Each write leaves one issue property (knovas.permit.&lt;permit id>, at most 32 KiB) on the issue; nothing removes them yet. | low |  |
